name: 240. Deferred tools on models without tool search use the gateway search (gateway tool search)
description: A request that defers tools (defer_loading) on a model with no tool search of its own (Gemini, older GPT, Bedrock non-Claude, ...) used to get every tool loaded up front. Bifrost now holds the deferred tools back and offers the model a bifrost_tool_search function; when the model calls it, Bifrost searches the deferred tools in the gateway, loads the matches and calls the model again, and the caller sees one response without the search call. Cases pin the upstream wire (raw_request carries bifrost_tool_search and no defer_loading) and that the search call never reaches the caller, on /v1/responses and the Anthropic messages route.

item.name: gemini/gemini-2.5-flash /v1/responses deferred function loads through the gateway tool search

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
var wire = typeof rr === 'string' ? rr : JSON.stringify(rr || null);
pm.test('gateway tool search responses: 200', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'want 200: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.test('gateway tool search responses: the upstream gets bifrost_tool_search, not defer_loading', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.be.ok;
pm.expect(wire, 'the gateway search function must reach the upstream: ' + wire.slice(0, 800)).to.include('bifrost_tool_search');
pm.expect(wire, 'defer_loading must not reach a model without tool search').to.not.include('defer_loading');
pm.test('gateway tool search responses: the search call never reaches the caller', function () {
var output = body.output || [];

pm.expect(output.filter(function (x) { return x.type === 'function_call' && x.name === 'bifrost_tool_search'; }).length, 'bifrost_tool_search leaked: ' + JSON.stringify(output).slice(0, 800)).to.eql(0);
output.filter(function (x) { return x.type === 'function_call'; }).forEach(function (call) {
pm.expect(['lookup_city_code', 'get_weather'], 'calls only declared tools').to.include(call.name);
pm.test('gateway tool search responses: the deferred get_weather was loaded and called', function () {
var calls = (body.output || []).filter(function (x) { return x.type === 'function_call' && x.name === 'get_weather'; });
pm.expect(calls.length, 'want a get_weather call - a text-only reply never exercises deferred loading: ' + JSON.stringify(body.output || []).slice(0, 800)).to.be.above(0);

item.name: gemini/gemini-2.5-flash messages route stream: deferred tool loads through the gateway tool search

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('gateway tool search messages stream: 200', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'want 200: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
var events = txt.split('\n').filter(function (l) { return l.indexOf('data: ') === 0; }).map(function (l) {
try { return JSON.parse(l.slice(6)); } catch (e) { return null; }
}).filter(function (e) { return e; });
pm.test('gateway tool search messages stream: one message, ending in message_stop, no error', function () {
pm.expect(txt, 'stream must not carry an error event: ' + txt.slice(0, 600)).to.not.include('event: error');
pm.expect(events.filter(function (e) { return e.type === 'message_start'; }).length, 'the search turns must splice into one message').to.eql(1);
pm.expect(events.filter(function (e) { return e.type === 'message_stop'; }).length, 'want exactly one message_stop: ' + txt.slice(-600)).to.eql(1);
pm.test('gateway tool search messages stream: the search call never reaches the caller', function () {
var uses = events.filter(function (e) { return e.type === 'content_block_start' && e.content_block && e.content_block.type === 'tool_use'; });
uses.forEach(function (e) {
pm.expect(e.content_block.name, 'bifrost_tool_search leaked into the stream').to.not.eql('bifrost_tool_search');
pm.expect(['lookup_city_code', 'get_weather'], 'calls only declared tools').to.include(e.content_block.name);
pm.test('gateway tool search messages stream: the deferred get_weather was loaded and called', function () {
var weather = events.filter(function (e) { return e.type === 'content_block_start' && e.content_block && e.content_block.type === 'tool_use' && e.content_block.name === 'get_weather'; });
pm.expect(weather.length, 'want a get_weather tool_use - a text-only stream never exercises deferred loading: ' + txt.slice(0, 800)).to.be.above(0);
